content: KƗLƗNJA NDANA SƗK YAAGILƗGA NYANA WUPUSEPUT
Nat njambɨ waambu sapmba Jisas sɨmagaga walɨndɨ. Nɨma sakwat nɨmba yisolaa lɨndi maa sapmba la vaala ndailaa ndalɨndɨ. yisolaa la nɨmba waambu sapmba lɨndi.
Pagwuga la wupuseputmba nɨma sakwat nyaangɨt ndi kat sɨmagagawandɨ. Sɨmagaga kupma wandɨ.
Awut wandɨ. Kɨlɨnja sɨk yaagilɨga nyan sɨk yaagivat yandɨ.
Yaagilɨndɨ maa nat sɨk nɨma sakwat angwa yambɨmba ndalɨndɨ, waavi yalaa kɨndi.
nat sɨk nɨma sakwat kambat tɨga tagu kɨpma kuvut tɨga kavamba ndandɨ. ndandɨ, kwiyatapman waatndɨ.
Njingwut tambɨ lɨndɨ maa nya sɨngwalɨtndɨ, njingwut law wandɨ, kiyandɨ.
Nat sɨk nɨma sakwat kavle yuwi sɨt tɨga kavamba ndandɨ. Kavle yuwi waataa kematndɨ maa yaaginda sɨk tegɨlɨlaa ndɨna sɨk ana kwandɨ.

Nat sɨk nɨma sakwat apma kɨpmamba ndandɨ. ndandɨ, sɨk kwandɨ. nat avamba sɨk kɨta ndumi kiyeli tamba vɨli kwandɨ. Nat avamba sɨk ndumi kuvuk kwandɨ. Nat avamba sɨk ndumi tambanat kwandɨ. apma maawut tɨga nyan wutaa yelavɨkyandɨ waa wandɨ Jisas.
PAGWUGA LA WUPUSEPUTNA VAK KAT JISAS MBUTNDƗ
Jisas wan nɨma sakwat nɨmba kat kwagalandɨ maa ndɨnanala lɨga nɨmbagwi wan tamba vɨli kiyeli vɨlɨlɨk nɨmbo ndɨkat pagwula la wapuseput kat wagalandi.
Ndi kat wandɨ. God vɨga lɨga vatna aytesɨgɨt ngwuk kat tamba sɨmogwiwun waa wandɨ. Nat nɨmba kai walɨga nɨmba pagwuga la wupuseput mɨna wukiyandi waa wandɨ.

Kai walɨga nɨmba maawut yelavɨtapman mɨni mɨna vɨga lɨgandi. Maawut yelavɨtapman waan mɨna wuka lɨgandi. Wungi vak vapmba kupi maawut ana yelavɨkiyandi. Kupi maawut yelavɨtnjeyan kavle vak yetɨnja vak kat God lɨmbwingiyandɨ waa wandɨ Jisas.
KƗLNJA NDANA SƗK YAAGILƗG NYANA WUPUSEPUTNA ANGWA VAK KAT JISAS NDI KAT MBUNDƗ
Ndi kat wandɨ. Wan pagwugala wupuseputna angwa yelavɨtapman yingweyan pagwuga la angwa vat angamak yelavɨka lɨgiyangwuk.
Kɨlɨnjandana sɨk yaagilɨnda vak vla apma nyaangɨt mbutɨgandɨ.
Way angwa yambɨmbalɨga kɨpma ndinyangu vla lɨgandɨ. Nyaangɨt mbutndɨ maa wutndi. Wutndi, Seten kwiyatapman yalaa mbutnda nyaangɨt klalaa kaliga yiga pagwundɨ.
Kambat tɨga tagu kɨpma kuvuk tɨga kɨpma ndinyangu vla lɨgandɨ. Nyaangɨt nolin ngwandɨga klandi.
Ndina maawut njingwut tapman nda vla lɨgandɨ. Samat tɨga nɨma vat tɨndɨ, wan apma nyaangɨt kat tɨga waleavat waleanjangat kwagalandi.
Nat nɨmba kavle yuwimba la kavamba yaaginda sɨk vla lɨgandi. nyaangɨt wutndi.
Kɨpmana kwanda kwandanda kat yelavɨtnja vak, mandɨp mandɨp nda klavat walɨnja vat, nɨma sakwat nɨmbundawi nolin ngwandɨga klalɨnja vak, nyaangɨkat kematndi maa sɨk ana kwandɨ.

Nat 20 nɨmba apma kɨpmamba yaaginda sɨk vla lɨgandi. nyaangɨt wutaa maawupmba kwutaa yuwi sɨk kwa vak vla apma njɨvwa kwukiyandi. Nat nyan sɨk ndumi vɨli kiyeli tamba vɨli kwa vak vla apma njɨvwa kwukiyandɨ. Nat nyan sɨk ndumi kuvuk kwa vak vla nɨma sakwat apma njɨvwa kwukiyandɨ. Nat nyan sɨk ndumi tambanat kwa vak vla nɨma nglei sakwat apma njɨvwa kwukiyandɨ.
SALƗNDI, VƗTƗGA YA AW YAPMBA ANA NAAGALƗGANDI
Jisas ndi kat wandɨ. Salɨndi, vɨtɨga ya aw yapmba njamba pulumba taagalɨkandi? Kai. Njambamba taagalɨgandi waa wandɨ.
Mbambla pagwuga lɨga nda ngɨni kapmba lɨgiyandɨ. Kapmonja nda vla nda ngɨni vɨgiyandi.
Maawut yelavɨta lɨgiyaa nyan awut.
Ndi kat wandɨ. yigumba awut. nat nɨmba kat yilɨngwa vak vla ngwuk kat wupma yigiyandi. Ndi kat nɨma vat yingweyan ngwuk kat nɨma anglei vat yigiyandi.
Maawupmba yelavɨka lɨga nyan ndɨ nɨma sakwat apma vat klaigandɨ. maawupmba yelavɨtapman tɨga nyan apma vat ana klaigandɨ. Tat kla la apma vat nat nyan ndɨnamba klalaa kaligiyandɨ.
WATNA SƗKNA WAPUSEPUT
God nɨn kat kwilɨga vat kɨpmamba sɨk yaagilɨga nyan vla lɨgandɨ.
Wan nyan ngan sɨndu kwalaa nandinya laatndɨ maa sɨt kwo waatndɨ. Waataa vat ana vɨndɨ.
Kɨpmamba lɨga avla waatndɨ. Tat ava. Ngɨni mwe tawndɨ. ngɨni sɨk kwandɨ.
Sɨk ak wulaa lɨndeyan kalɨtɨnda sɨva yandeyan yapmba kalɨtɨgandɨ waa wandɨ Jisas.
MASTET WALƗNJA SƗKNA WUPUSEPUT
Jisas wandɨ. God vɨga lɨga vat manda vat vla lɨgandɨ. Angamak vɨlɨnja wapuseputmba sɨmagagiyowun waa wandɨ.
Mastet walɨnja sɨk vla lɨgandɨ. Wan sɨk mak nglei nda.
Wan sɨk yaaginjeyan waakiyandɨ. Kaawa ava vla waakiyandɨ. Nɨma sandanala lɨgiyandɨ. ndɨna angɨmba wiyaka yetɨlɨga waavi ngay kwukiyandi.
Pagwuga lɨga wapuseput nɨma sakwat ndi kat ngambundɨ. Nat nɨmba wuka yelavɨtndi. Nat nɨmba kai.
Nat nɨmba kat pagwuga lɨga wapuseput mɨna mbutndɨ. Kapmba ana ndi kat mbutndɨ. Ndɨna mbaapma nɨmba kat wupma kai. Ndi kat kapmba nyaangɨtna angwa vɨsɨmogwindɨ.
JISAS MWUK PALI KAT KAI WANDƗ MAA KIYAK WANDƗ
Nat nandinya ngan ndandɨ, Jisas ndɨna mbaapma nɨmba kat wandɨ. Sak valigegat waa wandɨ.
Nat nɨmba kat kwagalalaa njaambɨt kulaa valɨgendi. Nat njaambɨt nɨmbun valɨgendi.
Yilɨndi maa nɨma mwutolo kwutndɨ, pali laatndɨ. nɨma pali laataa ndina njaambɨt wuleindɨ.
Jisas kwengwi njaambɨtmba lɨga sɨndu kwandɨ. Ndɨ kat sɨvɨlulaa wandi. Sɨmogwi lɨga nyan nɨna njaambɨt tamba kambruka tɨgandɨ. Nɨn kat ana yelavɨka lɨgamɨn?
Jisas laataa mwuk pali kat kai wandɨ maa kiyak wandɨ. Ngu yuvut tapman tɨndɨ.
Mwuk kat walaa ndi kat wandɨ. Ngwuk manda kat vaaka lɨgangwuk. njambwi nyanat tuwa vak ana yelavɨka lɨgangwuk? waa ndi kat wandɨ.

Wandɨ maa ndi ngɨpaliga ndalaa awat sowat wandi. Wan nyan anda nyana. mwuk pali ndɨnai waa vapmba wutɨnda waa wandi. atwandɨ. God waa nyaangɨt mbutɨga nyan kwo ngepma lɨndyan ndɨ kat apma maawut yelavɨkiyandi. ndɨna angwa ngepma lɨndeyan ndɨna ngepma nɨmba ndɨ kat kai waigandi waa wandɨ.
